input: AWS single-account mode (account_mode organization|single) and us-east-2 home region for platform/aws; runbook step 0
errors: A commit taken while the background tofu suite was running captured a temporarily regenerated baseline lock file; caught in the risk review's sensitive-file list and amended before push.

doc_friction.issue: The brief said provider-level dynamic blocks are not supported; with OpenTofu 1.13.10 and hashicorp/aws 6.72.0 a dynamic assume_role block in a provider plans cleanly (checked with a dummy-credential plan), and an empty role_arn only warns it will become an error. Recorded in platform/aws/README.md.

The bootstrap rule blocks every change under platform/aws/bootstrap/ with empty evidence, so an allowlist entry can only match the rule's own message and would clear all future bootstrap changes. Needed a temporary entry plus a removal PR; a digest- or PR-scoped entry would be safer.
registry.opentofu.org is blocked by the proxy; releases.hashicorp.com works, but its provider hashes differ from the lock files, so local tofu tests need the lock files set aside.

deviations.why: The brief asks for the boundary on every role; the key rotator cannot carry it because the boundary denies iam:CreateAccessKey, the rotator's only job.
deviations.did: Left the rotator without a boundary, documented and asserted in tests.
deviations.result: Every other single-mode role carries workload-boundary.

deviations.why: Payments' isolation from the public repository needs a separate account and an RCP, neither of which exists in one account.
deviations.did: No payments roles in single mode.

notes: Local verification: tofu test across 18 stacks all pass (single-mode runs added); tofu fmt -check clean; pytest platform/aws 86 pass; cfn-lint 1.61.0 clean on bootstrap.yaml; checkov 3.4.10 0 failed / 0 parse errors; ci_policy_check pass; adversarial gate 0 blocking with the allowlist from PR #19243 (merged first). Follow-up PR removes the temporary bootstrap allowlist entry.
